title: [VSC-24] VS Code chat: prefer the general channel when auto-selecting, and dedupe CHANNEL_CREATED by id, matching JetBrains
description:
Filed by VSC-18 (task-43363b5d) from its adversarial pass over the epic diff.
1. Channel auto-selection differs between the clients (architect comment-41ad6014 on VSC-18). JetBrains (VSC-22, ChatChannelSelection.choose) picks the still-listed id, else the general-type channel, else the first listed channel. VS Code media/chat.js updateChannels picks channels[0] after deselectChannel(), and on first load. The two agree only while #general is the oldest channel. Port choose() to chat.js (prefer ch.type === 'general', else channels[0]) and mirror ChatChannelSelectionTest cases (b) through (f).
2. VS Code MoeDaemonClient case 'CHANNEL_CREATED' pushes the payload into state.channels without checking its id, and chat.js 'channelCreated' does channels.push. A repeated frame lists the channel twice. JetBrains MoeMessageDispatcher replaces by id (filter { it.id != channel.id } + channel).
definitionOfDone: chat.js selects the general-type channel when the selection is gone or on first load, else the first listed channel; a node:test runs raw chat.js in vm over cases (b) to (f) of ChatChannelSelectionTest.
A repeated CHANNEL_CREATED with a known id leaves one entry in the client cache and in the chat.js list, with a test (tests/wire-parity.test.cjs style).
In a git-archive snapshot, moe-vscode `npm ci && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test` exits 0.
reopenReason: Governor promote under "keep the board moving" (10:52Z) and "go on the vscode epic". VSC-18 filed this from its adversarial pass. It is lane-free: no open row plans media/chat.js.
